objective: Determine whether the precise 17-edge one-sided instance takes 512 cases and derive a verified tree or best proven obstruction for its pencil.
status: Proved: A one-sided XOR of all eight even-numbered products on the 17-product path leaves the exact minimum at 512 cases and minimum worst depth nine. An optimal unbalanced tree closes 128 branches at depth eight, and the proof gives 2^k cases on every odd path of 2k−1 products with this sketch for k≥3.
title: Decide the 17-product even-edge sketch
